name: Dark Reader
title: Dark Reader: free Night Eye alternative
install: Download from your browser's add-on store
caption:
Night Eye Pro charges $9/year to put every website in dark mode. Dark Reader does it for free 🌙

✅ Turns any website dark with one click
✅ Brightness, contrast and sepia sliders
✅ On for every site, or only the ones you pick
✅ Doesn't send your data anywhere

💻 Chrome · Firefox · Edge
ℹ️ Free on Chrome, Edge and Firefox. The Safari version is a paid App Store app, and the team asks for an optional donation

dm_pitch: Dark Reader, the free open-source dark mode for every website 🌙

beats.say: Why is anyone still paying for dark mode on websites?
Night Eye Pro charges nine bucks a year. Dark Reader costs nothing.
Click once, and any website goes dark, even the blinding white ones.
Brightness, contrast and sepia all get sliders, so it looks exactly how you like.
Turn it on everywhere, or only on the sites you pick.
It's night mode for the whole internet, for free.
Comment Dark, and I'll send you the link.
